title: The Density of Thought: Predicting and Steering Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate whether variation in information density across chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning steps predicts answer correctness and can serve as a controllable inference-time target. We prompt frozen pretrained models to solve problems via CoT and measure the density of each reasoning step with two independent metrics: LP variance (how unevenly information is distributed across steps, computed as the variance in mean per-token negative log-likelihood) and the Caveman compression ratio. We then test whether density correlates with, and can be steered to improve, answer correctness. Experiments across six model scales, two training paradigms, and 60 GSM8K problems yield four main findings. First, lower LP variance predicts correctness in supervised fine-tuned (SFT) models, but this relationship weakens with scale and reverses in reinforcement-learning (RL) distilled models. Training paradigm therefore appears more influential than model

translated_title: 思维的密度：预测与引导大型语言模型中的推理
translated_abstract: 我们研究思维链推理各步骤中信息密度的变化是否能够预测答案的正确性，并可作为推理时可控制的目标。我们提示冻结的预训练模型通过思维链解决问题，并使用两个独立的指标测量每个推理步骤的密度：LP方差（信息在各步骤间分布的不均匀程度，计算为每个token平均负对数似然的方差）和Caveman压缩比。随后我们测试密度是否与答案正确性相关，并能否通过引导密度来提升正确性。在六个模型规模、两种训练范式和60个GSM8K问题上进行的实验得出了四个主要发现。首先，较低的LP方差可以预测监督微调（SFT）模型的正确性，但这种关系随模型规模增大而减弱，并在强化学习（RL）蒸馏模型中发生逆转。因此，训练范式似乎比模型规模更具影响力。
tldr: 该论文发现思维链推理各步骤的信息密度变化（LP方差）可预测大型语言模型答案的正确性，且这种预测关系在不同训练范式（SFT与RL蒸馏）下表现不同，为推理时通过引导信息密度提升模型正确性提供了新途径。
